# Invictus AI — Full Documentation

> AI-powered patient growth systems built exclusively for dental clinics in India.

Invictus AI is a niche dental marketing agency founded by Sahil Bagul. Unlike generic digital agencies, we work exclusively with dental clinics across India — from single-chair practices in Tier 2 cities to multi-location clinics in metros. We build automated patient acquisition systems using AI, modern web technology, and data-driven advertising.

---

## Who We Serve

We serve dental clinics of all sizes across India. Our clients typically include:
- Independent dental practitioners looking to get their first online patients
- Multi-chair clinics wanting to scale beyond word-of-mouth referrals
- Multi-location chains needing consistent branding and marketing across locations
- New clinic owners who want to launch with a strong digital presence from Day 1

---

## Our Services

### 1. Dental Clinic Website Design

We build high-converting, mobile-first websites specifically for dental clinics.

**What's included:**
- Custom responsive design (not WordPress templates)
- Treatment pages with local SEO optimization
- Google Maps integration
- WhatsApp click-to-chat integration
- Online appointment booking forms
- Google PageSpeed optimization (target: 90+ score)
- Structured data markup (LocalBusiness, MedicalBusiness schema)

**Pricing:**
- Standard Package: Starts at ₹7,000 (one-time) — up to 5 pages, 3 revision rounds
- Premium Package: Starts at ₹13,000 (one-time) — up to 10 pages, 5 revision rounds, blog setup, advanced SEO
- Pricing varies based on requirements and complexity

**Learn more:** [/services/clinic-website](https://invictus-ai.in/services/clinic-website)

---

### 2. Meta Ads & Social Media Content

We run hyper-local Instagram and Facebook ad campaigns targeted within a 5km radius of the clinic.

**What's included:**
- Audience research and targeting setup
- Ad creative design (carousel, video, story formats)
- Content calendar with 8–12 posts per month
- Monthly performance reporting
- WhatsApp-direct lead generation campaigns
- A/B testing and optimization

**Pricing:** Starts at ₹8,000/month (plus ad spend)

**Typical results:**
- 200–300% increase in patient inquiries within 60 days
- Cost per lead: ₹80–₹200 depending on city tier
- Average ROI: 10–15x on ad spend

**Learn more:** [/services/meta-ads](https://invictus-ai.in/services/meta-ads)

---

### 3. AI Website Chatbot

A 24/7 AI receptionist trained on the clinic's data that answers patient queries and books appointments.

**What's included:**
- Custom chatbot trained on clinic services, pricing, and FAQs
- WhatsApp and website widget integration
- Appointment booking capability
- Lead capture with email/phone collection
- Monthly conversation analytics

**Pricing:** ₹3,000/month

**Learn more:** [/services/ai-chatbot](https://invictus-ai.in/services/ai-chatbot)

---

### 4. Automated Google Review Management

We set up an automated system that collects 5-star reviews from patients after every visit.

**What's included:**
- Automated WhatsApp review request messages (sent 2 hours post-appointment)
- 'Happy Patient Filter' — routes unsatisfied patients to private feedback
- Google review link generation
- Review response templates
- Monthly review analytics dashboard

**Pricing:** ₹3,000/month

**Typical results:**
- 3.8★ → 4.9★ Google rating in 4 months
- 500%+ increase in total review count
- Improved Google Maps (Local Pack) ranking

**Learn more:** [/services/reputation-management](https://invictus-ai.in/services/reputation-management)

## Results & Case Studies

### Case Study 1: Dr. P.K., Pune
- **Service:** Meta Ads
- **Before:** 8–10 new patient inquiries/month (referral only)
- **After:** 30+ inquiries/month at ₹120/lead
- **Timeline:** 60 days
- **ROI:** ~15x

### Case Study 2: Dr. A.D., Nashik
- **Service:** Reputation Management
- **Before:** 3.8★ rating, 12 reviews, Local Pack #7
- **After:** 4.9★ rating, 80+ reviews, Local Pack #1
- **Timeline:** 4 months

### Case Study 3: Dr. S.P., Aurangabad
- **Service:** Clinic Website
- **Before:** Outdated non-responsive site, PageSpeed 23/100, zero organic traffic
- **After:** PageSpeed 94/100, 12 keywords ranking, 3 appointment inquiries in Week 1
- **Timeline:** 10 days build

**All case studies:** [/case-studies](https://invictus-ai.in/case-studies)
